ANSWER: NO

HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately represents all key financial terms found in the source document. All specific details including:

- Parties (Bank of Montreal as Administrative Agent, MGE Niagara Entertainment Inc. as Borrower, Complex Services Inc. as guarantor)
- Dates (September 30, 2020 waiver date, November 30, 2020 Extended Waiver Period, original credit agreement June 10, 2019, amendment July 17, 2019)
- Interest rates and pricing (Level 5 Applicable Margin: 5.00% for Bankers' Acceptances/Letters of Credit/LIBOR Loans, 3.50% for Prime Rate/USBR Loans, 1.25% Undrawn Fee)
- Covenant terms ($15,000,000 minimum liquidity, no new advances, weekly reporting, restricted distributions, no acquisitions)
- Waived sections (9.4.1, 9.4.2 financial covenants, section 11.1.11 closure default)
- OLG relief terms (5 business day limits for payment cessation)

are all directly supported by the source document. The memo appropriately notes "N/A" for terms not specified in this waiver document (deal size, deal price, maturity date, payment frequency) rather than fabricating information.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
- Original credit agreement date (June 10, 2019, amended July 17, 2019)
- Previous waiver dates and timeline (May 15, 2020 May Limited Waiver, June 15, 2020 First June Limited Waiver, June 30, 2020 Second June Limited Waiver, July 31, 2020 July Limited Waiver)
- Specific financial covenant sections being waived (Sections 9.4.1 and 9.4.2 of the Credit Agreement)
- Compliance certificate delivery requirements being waived (Q1 Compliance Certificate for Fiscal Quarter ending June 30, 2020, Q2 Compliance Certificate for Second Quarter ending September 30, 2020, Annual Business Plan for Operating Year ending March 31, 2020)
- Event of Default section reference (Section 11.1.11 of the Credit Agreement for Closure Default)
- Complete pricing grid from Schedule B showing all leverage ratio levels and corresponding rates
- Governing law (laws of the Province of Ontario and federal laws of Canada)
